0022600136.text: The Orlando Magic (0-2) travel to face the Toronto Raptors (2-0), who have won both of their games and sit 3rd in the East, while Orlando is 13th in the East and has lost its last two. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero, who is averaging 24.5 points in 33.8 minutes per game this season, along with Izaiyah Nelson, Jonathan Isaac, and Noah Penda, while Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram, Kawhi Leonard, and Nate Bittle. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season series the Magic lost 1-2, including a 139-87 loss in Toronto on March 29, 2026.
